# Loui DS

> Loui DS is a dark, minimal, functional React design system (React 19, React Aria Components, CSS Modules, DTCG tokens) for internal tools, dashboards and apps. It is built to be operated by humans and AI agents.

Package @loui/ds@0.0.0. Entry points: `@loui/ds`, `@loui/ds/patterns`, `@loui/ds/styles.css`. All component and token names below are exact; do not invent others.

Rules for generated UI:

- Use only components, hooks and tokens exported by the package; never write raw colors, px sizes, z-indexes or inline styles.
- One primary action per screen (`Button variant="primary"`), top right. The accent blue is for focus, selection and links only.
- Hierarchy comes from surface plus border; shadows only on overlays.
- Color never carries meaning alone: pair it with text or an icon with a name.
- Every interactive element needs an accessible name; icon-only controls require a `label`.
- Microcopy: English, sentence case, buttons are verb + object, no exclamation marks, no emoji. See content-rules.json.
- No user-visible string literals in components: use the message catalog and `DSProvider`.
- Money is integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code; format dates, numbers and money with the provided utilities.
- Do not use `experimental` or `deprecated` components in recipes or generated code unless the user asks.

## Guides

- [Introduction](./guides/introduction.md): What Loui DS is and how it is organized.
- [Getting started](./guides/getting-started.md): Install, load the stylesheet, wrap the app in DSProvider, fonts, SSR.
- [Principles](./guides/principles.md): The three visual rules, the product principles and the agent principles.
- [Content guidelines](./guides/content-guidelines.md): Microcopy rules: tone, casing, buttons, errors, empty states, numbers.
- [Accessibility](./guides/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AA target, keyboard model and how it is tested.
- [Using with AI](./guides/using-with-ai.md): The manifest, llms.txt, content rules and Storybook MCP.

## Components

- [Alert](./ai/components/Alert.md): An inline message with a tone, an icon, an optional title, an action and a dismiss button. (experimental)
- [Avatar](./ai/components/Avatar.md): A circular photo or initials of a person, in grays (never a color per person). (experimental)
- [Badge](./ai/components/Badge.md): A pill with a short status label. (experimental)
- [Button](./ai/components/Button.md): An action button built on React Aria's `Button`. (experimental)
- [Card](./ai/components/Card.md): A bordered surface that groups related content. (experimental)
- [Checkbox](./ai/components/Checkbox.md): A checkbox with a native `<input type="checkbox">` (so `name` / `value` take part in form submission), an 18px box and an optional description. (experimental)
- [CheckboxGroup](./ai/components/CheckboxGroup.md): A labelled `role="group"` of checkboxes that share one value (`string[]`), one `name`, and one description and error. (experimental)
- [Description](./ai/components/Description.md): Helper text under a field (the handoff `hint`). (experimental)
- [EmptyState](./ai/components/EmptyState.md): Tells the user that there is nothing to show, why, and what to do next. (experimental)
- [FieldError](./ai/components/FieldError.md): Error text of a field. (experimental)
- [FieldMessages](./ai/components/FieldMessages.md): Description followed by the error: the footer every field renders under its control. (experimental)
- [Icon](./ai/components/Icon.md): An inline SVG icon (Lucide, bundled) that inherits the text color and draws a 1.5px stroke. (experimental)
- [IconButton](./ai/components/IconButton.md): A square button with a single icon and a required accessible name. (experimental)
- [Input](./ai/components/Input.md): Single-line text field: label, control, description and error wired together (`for`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`), built on React Aria `TextField`. (experimental)
- [Kbd](./ai/components/Kbd.md): A keyboard shortcut hint in mono type. (experimental)
- [Label](./ai/components/Label.md): The visible label of a field. (experimental)
- [Link](./ai/components/Link.md): A link built on React Aria's `Link`. (experimental)
- [Meter](./ai/components/Meter.md): A bar that shows a quantity within a known range (disk used, quota, score), as opposed to progress of a task. (experimental)
- [Progress](./ai/components/Progress.md): A thin bar for a task that makes progress: determinate with a `value`, or indeterminate when the amount is unknown. (experimental)
- [Radio](./ai/components/Radio.md): One option of a `RadioGroup`. (experimental)
- [RadioGroup](./ai/components/RadioGroup.md): A labelled `role="radiogroup"` of mutually exclusive options with native radio inputs. (experimental)
- [RequiredMark](./ai/components/RequiredMark.md): The visible marker of a required field, text from messages. (experimental)
- [Select](./ai/components/Select.md): A single-choice dropdown built on React Aria `Select`: a button that opens a listbox in a popover. (experimental)
- [Skeleton](./ai/components/Skeleton.md): A placeholder block in the shape of content that is still loading. (experimental)
- [Spinner](./ai/components/Spinner.md): An indeterminate loading ring that inherits the text color. (experimental)
- [Switch](./ai/components/Switch.md): An on/off setting that applies immediately. (experimental)
- [Tag](./ai/components/Tag.md): A mono outlined label for versions, SKUs and filters. (experimental)
- [TagGroup](./ai/components/TagGroup.md): A group of tags with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation. (experimental)
- [Textarea](./ai/components/Textarea.md): Multi-line text field built on React Aria `TextField` + `TextArea`. (experimental)
- [VisuallyHidden](./ai/components/VisuallyHidden.md): Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology. (experimental)

## Hooks, utilities and icons

- [Hooks and utilities](./ai/hooks-and-utilities.md): useControllableState, useDSLocale, useHotkey, useMediaQuery, useMessages, usePrefersReducedMotion; 28 utilities and constants; 24 icons.

## Machine-readable data

- [manifest.json](./manifest.json): every export with props, variants, messages, CSS variables, stories and doc sections (30 components).
- [tokens.json](./tokens.json): 232 design tokens with CSS variables, values, descriptions and allowed text/surface pairings.
- [content-rules.json](./ai/content-rules.json): microcopy rules as data.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): guides, token summary and every component page in one file.
